MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.

2. When practising Listening for Gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist.

3. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

4. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.

5. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
6. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological Awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. In three clear sentences, explain Imitative Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Imitative Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
